title: The Treasure Beneath Multiple Annotations: An Uncertainty-Aware Edge Detector
mechanism: Model multiple annotations as a learnable per-pixel Gaussian; variance is the uncertainty; loss re-weighted toward uncertain pixels.
adaptation: Treat the 2021 and 2022 crack label versions as two annotators; sample one per iteration; learn mean and variance; read out the mean. Variance map also feeds a benchmark uncertainty view.
min_experiment: Arm = PF with UAED crack head on both label versions; baseline = PF on 2022 labels; 5 seeds + CV; metrics crack IoU (2022 labels), relF1@2. Kill if IoU drops > 0.01 with no relF1@2 gain.
evidence: R: CVPR 2023 SOTA on multi-annotator edge sets (BSDS); numbers not read.
prior_overlap: None; old labels were never used as a second annotator.

alt_notes.adaptation: Take per-pixel disagreement from the 2021 vs 2022 crack label versions. Run it as a sub-arm of the RankED test, because RankED reports the opposite weighting works better.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Sub-arm of the RankED experiment. Baseline: house at 100% labels. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill if n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Disagreement from 2021 vs 2022 crack masks on the same cells; Gaussian label on crack logit. Run as a sub-arm of the RankED test because RankED found the opposite weighting better.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Sub-arm of RankED test: house + UAED weighting, 5 seeds vs house. Kill if crack IoU and relF1@2 n.d.
